_comment: "{r}, destroy this, CHARGE your hero's soul: Target attack gains +2{p}" -- the charge is part of the COST, not an effect. Authored as an ON_PLAY effect it made the reaction legal with an EMPTY HAND: the ability resolved and the cost was simply never paid. CHARGE also took hand position 0 with nobody choosing, so a player could lose the card they most wanted to keep. CR 8.5.29.
